architecture: SmallViT depth4 d32 heads4 mlp64 on sklearn digits
span_rationale: central two Transformer blocks, fixed before confirmatory outcomes to avoid embedding/head edge effects

strategies.componentwise: replace block1 and block2 independently; each choice identity or one compiler block; component compilers trained on teacher intermediate targets
strategies.composed: replace the two-block input-output map directly with identity or one compiler block

optimization.note: componentwise may use up to twice the compiler updates; this favors componentwise rather than composed

selection: within each strategy, select the passing candidate with minimum replacement parameters, tie-break by lower holdout NMSE; test metrics are not used for selection
primary_hypothesis: minimal passing composed replacement complexity is lower than minimal passing componentwise replacement complexity
